title.narrative: Improving Fiscal Management and Tax Compliance Capacity in the Government of Armenia

description.narrative: The development objective of this grant is to strengthen fiscal management of the Government of Armenia by improving the capacity of the Ministry of Finance and the State Revenue Committee to manage tax compliance and macro-economic and fiscal analysis, and planning. Management of tax compliance is proposed to be strengthen through introduction and institutionalization of risk based audit selection and development of skills for high quality tax audit of complicated cases, based on transfer of knowledge from international expertise. Management of fiscal planning and analysis is proposed to be achieved through enhancement of macro-economic planning and forecasting capacities in the Ministry of Finance.
